Commentary.Commentary: Now then! What will Ireland be thinking? Take the lead, bat for as long as possible? You bet, they would sense a real opportunity here to go way ahead in the game. England on the other hand, need wickets and that too quickly. You can't rule that out though, seeing the class they have in the bowling line-up and with the wicket assisting the bowlers, we are in for an exciting passage of play after Lunch. Join us in a while.

Not a lot you can write about the English batting line-up. 8 of them failed to get to double digits out of which three were dismissed for ducks. 23 by Denly is their top scorer and Olly Stone, the man who came out to bat second last, is their second highest scorer. A very sorry display by their batters.

WOW! How many of you all expected the game to be where it is at the moment? Not once had I thought, Ireland would, let alone win a session but even have a chance of doing so but they have proved me and surely many others wrong. After being asked to field, their bowlers have delivered and in some way. Tim Murtagh and Mark Adair ran through the English batting line-up. The latter played more of a supporting role whereas the former was the mainstay. He picked his maiden fifer in his first spell itself. Boyd Rankin then joined the party and bagged two for himself. Thompson can be a touch disappointed with how he bowled but overall, Ireland will be over the moon at the moment.

It is Tim Murtagh, the 37-year old, the star of today for Ireland, the tormentor-in-chief leads them off the field. He receives a standing ovation as he does and it is well deserved. It is due to his efforts, Ireland head into the LUNCH BREAK as the happier side.

OUT! Plays it on! The bowling change does the trick for Ireland. Extra bounce does the trick for Adair here. It is on a length and around middle, takes off after pitching. Stone looks to defend but the ball hits his arm and then deflects onto the stumps. ENGLAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 85!

FOUR! A little too full this time by Adair. The ball was there to be hit wide outside off and Olly gives it the treatment. He gets down on one knee and drives it through the point region for a boundary.
Fullish ball outside off again by Adair. Stone mistimes it as the ball rolls to the cover fielder.
Wide outside off and full in length by Adair. Stone throws his bat at it but misses.
Mark Adair is back on!
Good length delivery on off stump, Leach tries to defend off the back foot but misses it.
Ian Ward on air says that the lunch can be extended till 1.30 p.m local.
This time a good length delivery on off stump, Leach defends it towards the off side.
Rankin keeps the short ball going, this time on the off side. Leach attempts to cut it but plays and misses.
Another short delivery on the leg stump, Leach ducks under it to allow the ball to go back to the keeper.
Short ball outside off stump, Leach leaves it alone again.
Short delivery on the leg side, Leach lets it go back to the keeper.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over! Thompson is leaking runs. This is fuller and around off, Stone strokes it through covers and it races away. 12 from the over. A very expensive one.
Goes back to bowling on a length, it is kept out.
Straight down the ground! This is fuller and on middle, Stone shows the full face of the bat and strokes it past mid on and it races away. Consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! These are handy runs for England. A full ball outside off, Stone drives it square on the off side and it races away to the fence.
On the stumps, Stone hits it back towards the bowler.
This is outside off, it is left alone.
Single of the last ball. The ball is bowled onto the pads of Stone by Rankin.   Stone turns it towards the fine leg fielder for a run.
Similar length to the last ball. Rankin bowls it full trying to induce the drive and Stone responds by pushing it to mid on. No runs taken.
Stones pushes this fullish ball off the front foot towards mid on.
This time Rankin misses his mark a bit and bowls it on the pads of Leach. He flicks it to square leg and gets off the mark as the batters take a single.
Boyd welcomes Leach to the crease with the short ball. He ducks under it and lets it go to the keeper.
Jack Leach is the new man in.

OUT! There goes England's last hope of taking them close to the 100-run mark. A sharp catch by the short leg fielder. This is on the pads, Curran works it but does not keep it down. It goes low to the fielder there who is in a good position and he hangs onto it.
Good shot from Curran, Good length delivery from Thompson which is going down leg. Curran plays it towards mid-wicket and the batsmen run three to keep Curran on strike for the next over.
Good length delivery on leg stump, Stone glances it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length delivery, on the pads, Stone gets hit on the pads and there is a mild appeal for an LBW but it is going past leg.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Curran gets an inside edge and goes towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball, on middle stump, Stone misses and gets hit on the pads. A quick single taken.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Stone tries to defend it but gets an outside edge which falls short of the first slip fielder

Curran is living dangerously here which should be avoided in this situation. Boyd bowls it on a shortish length on the off pole line. Curran tries to pull it but gets a top edge to it. The ball flies to the empty region behind the keeper and the batters are able to pick up a couple of runs. End of a successful over for the Irish.

Stone is off the mark in edgy fasion. Rankin hits the deck hard on the fourth stump line. It swings onto the middle and off pole line. Stone plays at it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball goes to the third man region where the batters are able to pick up a single.
Olly Stone is the new man in.

OUT! There is an edge! Once again, brilliant use of the review by England. Boyd Rankin takes just the 4 balls to strike. This is around off and it is a little shorter in length. Broad looks to defend but there is a sound as the ball passes the bat. The keeper, William Porterfield takes it brilliantly by diving to his right. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Ireland review and Ultra Edge shows a spike as it passes the bat. Ireland continue to stay on top here.
Ireland have taken a review for caught behind. They are confident they have got their man.  Let's see what the replays have to say.
Rankin bowls it short again. Broad pushes it back to him off the back foot. The plan by the Irish here looks to bowl short to Broad.
A short leg coming in place! Broad maybe getting more of the short stuff here.
Shortish this time on the body of Broad by Rankin. He tucks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
On the money first up. Boyd bowls it on the middle pole line on a length. Broad defends it off the back foot to the cover fielder.
Boyd Rankin is on now!
Another dot to end! This thoughwas creamed. Fuller and on off, Curran hits it hard but to extra cover.
Down the leg side, Curran lets it go by. These are not wided in the longer format.
Another good length ball on off, Curran pushes it to covers.
Back of a length and on off, Curran stands tall and keeps it out.
Well bowled! This is what he should be bowling. On a length and around off, slants away the angle. Curran looks to push at it but it goes off the outside edge to gully.
Another poor ball by Thompson! He gets away with it. It is very full and outside off, Curran drives it square on the off side but finds point.

Uppish but in the gap! A couple to end! This is on the fuller side around off, Broad plays a check-drive over covers. The fielder at mid off hares after it and pushes it back in just before the ropes. The umpire does go upstairs to check if it is a boundary but replays show that the fielder has done well.
5 dots in a row as this length ball is pushed to mid off.
Continues landing it on a length and around off, Broad keeps it out.
Top class stuff! This is just outside off, Broad lets it be.
Another good length ball around off, Broad guides it towards point.
A muted appeal! This is around leg stump and then comes back in. Broad looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. It is going down leg.
A single to end a very good over for England. 13 from it. Good length and on off, this is pushed towards cover-point for one.
Good length and on off, this is kept out.
Three now! Stuart has not started well. He bowls this one very full again and on off, Curran jams it past mid off and bags three.
Another fuller one on off, Curran mistimes it to mid on.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This time off the edge! Good length and on off, Curran looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge through backward point and for a boundary.

FOUR! Not timed that well but hit well enough for it to reach the ropes! Poor bowling by Thompson. He has to continue the pressure built by the opening bowlers. He serves a half volley outside off, Curran hits it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Starts off with a no ball! This is outside off, it is left alone.
Change in bowling. Stuart Thompson is introduced into the attack.
Another good length delivery, Broad prods forward to defend it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Broad lets it go back to the keeper.
Good length delivery with a little bit of a swing on it. Broad gets hit on the pads and there is an appeal for LBW but turned down.
Shorter and on middle, Broad hops and defends it.
The new man in is Stuart Broad. He can bat but has not been very good with the willow in the recent past.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Tim Murtagh has a fifer to his name! His first in Tests and what a venue to get it and what a time to get it. All those years of playing for Middlesex is paying off here. Outstanding from him. Moeen Ali walks back for a duck. Once again, the line and the length is perfect. It is around off, pitches and moves away. Moeen once again plays it inside the line and the ball kisses the outside edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Good length delivery straying on the pads, Curran glances it to fine leg for a single. He is off the mark.
Finally bowls one on the stumps in this over. Moeen taps it back to the bowler.
This one is pitched outside off and it comes in with the angle. Moeen though knows where his off stump is and leaves it alone.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on the fourth stump line. Moeen is not tempted to drive this and he watchfully leaves it alone.
This is closer to off pole but Moeen has nothing to do with it.
Way outside off, Moeen shoulders arms to it.
Fuller outside off, Moeen keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it alone.
The new man in is Sam Curran. He will need to play a gem of a knock here to get his side out of trouble.

OUT! Umpire's call and Woakes now has to take the long walk back! This is unreal stuff, just unbelievable. Who would have thought England would be struggling and how! Second wicket in the over for Murtagh and 4th overall. He is breathing fire at the moment. Once again it is the movement off the pitch which gets the better of the batter. It pitches on off and then jags back in sharply. Woakes like a few other English batter, ends up playing outside the line. The ball hits him high on the back pad. An appeal follows and the finger is up. An appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Woakes reviews. Replays roll and they show that the ball is clipping the top of middle. England don't lose their review though but are in big, big trouble here.
Have Ireland got another? Woakes has been given out LBW but he has reviewed. Has he got an inside edge or is it going over? It looks like it could be overturned.
Short delivery outside off stump, Woakes lets it go back to the keeper.
Chris Woakes walks out to bat now. He would not have expected to walk out so soon today when he came to the ground.

OUT! TIMBER! Right through the gate! England are five down and they have not even crossed 50. It seems like they are still in the hangover of their World Cup win. Another excellent delivery by Murtagh. This is fuller and around off, it tails back in late. Bairstow leaves a gap between bat and pad as he looks to drive, it sneaks through and hits the off pole. Into the bowling all-rounders now are Ireland.
Short ball on off stump, Bairstow stands back and pushes it to mid off.
Another good length ball on off stump, Bairstow defends it towards mid off.
Fuller and on off, Bairstow strokes it back past the bowler, it hits the stumps at the other end and deflects toward mid off.
Moeen Ali is the new man in. England are in deep, deep trouble here.

OUT! Three reds and Root has been given his marching orders! Ireland all over England at the moment. Root, England's main batter, is walking back without making a lot of impact. Excellent use of the review by the Irish. Adair has his second now. This is on off and on a length. It jags back in. Root misses the ball as he tries to defend and gets his on the pads. A huge appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. The Ireland players can't believe it. Their skipper though has a doubt whether there is an inside edge. He goes for the review right at the end and it proves to be the right decision. Replays roll in and it shows the on-field call has to be overturned. Pin-drop silence here.
Ireland review! A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down. Looks very close. Root is the man in question. Big moment in the game.
Goes back to bowling it just outside off, Root lets it be.

FOUR LEG BYES! Appeal for LBW by the Irish. Adair pitches it on middle and leg on good length, the ball nips back into Joe Root with the angle. Looks to be going down the leg pole from the naked eye. It hits the front pad of Root and the ball rolls down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Well left again. Adair is looking to bowl outside off to induce the drive from Root. Root shoulders arms to this one though.
Root is off the mark. Length ball outside off, he gets close to the ball and guides it to third man for a couple of runs.
On a length outside off, the ball swings away from Root. He leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Bairstow misses the ball and gets hit on the waist. Excellent over from Murtagh comes to an end.
That was very late! Bairstow pulls out at the very end, after the bowler delivers. The ball hits the stumps but it is given as a dead ball.

Some confusion out there! Bairstow feels the over is done and has walked down the ground to have a word with Root. The umpire though walks up to him and asks him to resume batting as there is still a ball to go.
Short ball outside off stump, Bairstow lets it go back to the keeper.
Jonny Bairstow is the new man in. England have lost their top 3 here, Bairstow and Root will need to steady the ship here.

OUT! There goes another one! England are in a spot of bother now. Murtagh gets his second. Another good catch, this time by the keeper. Tim bowls it slightly fuller around off, it tails away late. Burns looks to drive but he ends up playing inside the line. The ball goes off the outside edge and low towards the keeper who takes a good tumbling catch. Ireland are making excellent use of the new ball here.
Fuller length ball on middle stump, Burns pushes it to mid on. Another dot ball.
Another good length delivery on middle stump, Burns defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on middle stump, Burns defends it towards mid on.
A beauty to end! This is angled into the off pole and then Adair gets it to tail away. Root looks to defend but is beaten by the movement. A brilliant over by Adair comes to an end.
Skipper, Joe Root walks out to bat now.

OUT! That is plumb in front! Adair gets one now and it is a well-deserved wicket. He has really been bowling well since the start and he gets the reward. The in-dipper catches Denly off guard. It starts from outside off and it tails back in. Denly ends up playing outside the line. The ball hits the back pad. A huge appeal follows and the umpire has his finger up immediately. This is a good start for Ireland.
This is on the pads, Denly works it wide of fine leg and takes an easy two.
Inside edge! Fuller and outside off, Denly looks to drive it away from the body. It goes off the inside edge and then onto the pads.
WIDE! It is way too short and down the leg side, Denly ducks under it.
On the off pole and it is on a length. Denly defends it onto the ground.
Down the leg side, Denly looks to flick but misses.
Good length delivery outside off, once again Burns has a go at it but misses.
Bowled way outside off on a length by Murtagh, Rory tries to get bat to ball but misses.
Murtagh bowls it on middle and leg. Burns pushes it towards the mid-wicket fielder off his pads.
Pitched in line of the middle stump, Burns pushes it back off the back foot. It goes back to the bowler.
Ooohh! Edged but falls short. The ball is pitched on a length on middle and nips away from Burns. He nicks it but it falls just short of the slip fielder.
Pitched on leg and middle, Burns pushes it to mid-wicket and takes a couple.
FOUR! Good length delivery on the pads, Denly glances it towards the deep mid-wicket for his third boundary.
Goes back to bowling an outswinger! This is very full on off. Denly jams it out.
An inswinger from Adair on middle stump, Denly faisl to read it and the ball brushes his pad and goes back to the keeper.
Good length delivery, outside off stump, Denly lets it go back to the keeper.

Edged and Four, Adair continues to bowl a probing line.  It was a good length delivery and outside off stump. Denly pushes at it and gets an edge which goes past the third slip fielder for a boundary.
Short delivery outside off stump, Denly lets it go.
A dot to end! Back of a length on off, it is kept out.

Confusion, a slip but no harm done in the end! This is fuller and around off, Denly pushes it through covers. He takes one and wants a second but then is sent back. He slips as he looks to turn but gets back onto his feet and dives to get in.
Back of a length and on off, once again it is blocked.
Another good length ball on off, Denly gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Back of a length on off, this is defended.
Short delivery, outside off stump, Denly leaves it alone.
Excellent bowling from Adair, kept it back outside off stump. Denly tries to defend but misses it.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Through cover this time. Slightly fuller again and on off, Denly leans into it and strokes it through covers and the ball races away.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Denly, full length delivery outside off stump, Denly prods forward and drives it towards the cover boundary for the first four of the game.
Good length ball on middle stump, Denly defends again but this time towards mid on.
Short ball on off stump, Denly defends it to the off side. No run.
Good length ball on off, Burns plays it to point.

Indecision from Denly there. Good length ball outside off, it comes back in after pitching. Denly initially looks to defend but then decides to leave. He is too late though as when he takes his bat up the ball hits his bat. Luckily for him he plays it with soft hands. The ball goes to the man at slip on a bounce. The man there misfields allowing them to take one. Denly needs to be more careful here and not be in two minds.
Length delivery around off, Denly guides it to the man at backward point.
Again maintains the same length and it is on off, Joe defends it off the front foot.
Now bowls it on top of off, ,Denly defends it off the front foot with authority.
Beauty! Good length ball pitching outside off, it comes back in just a bit.  Denly looks to defend but gets beaten.

Denly is off the mark courtesy a thickish outside edge! This is fuller and around off, it shapes away. denly ends up playing inside the line, the ball goes off the outside edge through backward point for three.
1 run. Good length ball on leg stump, Burns glances it towards the leg side where the fielder makes an excellent diving stop. A single taken.
Good length delivery outside off stump, Rory Burns leaves it alone. Good stuff from Mark Adair
On the stumps this time, gets the third ball right. Burns defends it onto the ground.
Another short ball outside off stump, Burns lets it go again.
Short ball, outside off stump, Burns lets it go to the keeper.
A dot to end a successful first over. Fuller and on off, Denly drives it back towards the bowler.
That stays low! Denly plays it well in the end! This is on off, it does not bounce a lot. Denly gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Joe Denly walks out at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Roy's luck runs out! A poor outing on his debut. Ireland have struck early and they are mighty delighted. Just the start they would have wanted. This is a very good nut by Murtagh. It is on a length around off and shaping away just a little. Roy is drawn into the stroke. He pushes at it a little too hard. The ball goes off the outside edge low to first slip where Stirling takes it nicely.
Another length ball on off, Roy plays a defensive push to mid off.
A little too straight, Burns works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length on off, this is kept out.
A dot to end a good over by Adair! Back of a length on off, Roy stands tall and keeps it out.

Adair has overstepped or Roy was a goner there! Roy is playing with all the luck possible at the moment. This is quite straight. Roy looks to flick but misses. He is trapped right in front but the umpire has his one hand raised sideways.

Almost plays it on! Roy was in two minds there. This is in the corridor of uncertainty. Roy initially looks to play at it but then tries to bail out. Too late by then, the ball hits the bottom edge and goes past the leg pole and down to fine leg for two.
A little away movement there but the line is way outside off. Roy lets it be. First signs of the ball doing something but the line and length was not the right one.
Gets it right this time! It is on off and on a length, Roy guides it to gully.
Roy misses out there! This is short and outside off, asking to be hit. Roy cuts but straight to point.
Some zip off the surface for Adair. This is on the pads, skids through. Roy looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Mark Adair to partner Murtagh from the other end.

Roy is up and running in Test cricket with a three! Another fuller length delivery around off, Roy just leans into it and pushes it past mid off. He runs three. Good lines and lengths by Murtagh in the first over but no assistance for him.
A solid looking drive first up by Roy. Just shows what confidence he comes into in this game. Fuller in length and on middle, Roy strokes it right off the middle to mid on.
England and Burns are underway! Slightly fuller around off, Burns looks to drive but it goes off the inner half, through covers and the batters take one.
On the stumps for the third ball in a row, Burns works it to mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller this time but no swing on offer, it is once again on off. Burns is solid in defense again.
Starts off right on the money! It is on a length and around off, Burns defends it.
Time for the action to begin! The England openers, Jason Roy and Rory Burns make their way out to the middle. The left-hander will be on strike and he will face Tim Murtagh. Here we go...
Ireland (Playing XI) - William Porterfield (C), Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie, James McCollum, Kevin O Brien, Gary Wilson (WK), Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Stuart Thompson, Boyd Rankin, Tim Murtagh.
England (Playing XI) - Rory Burns, Jason Roy, Joe Denly, Joe Root (C), Jonny Bairstow (WK), Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, Chris Woakes, Olly Stone, Stuart Broad, Jack Leach.
It is toss time at Lord's. England have won the toss and choose to bat.

Test match cricket is back after a long break, 133 days to be precise, however, this is not the typical 5-day Test but a 4-day game and it is a clash between the neighbors, England and Ireland in the home of cricket, Lord's. It is a chance for the hosts to prepare for the upcoming all important Ashes. However, it will be interesting to see if they are over their World Cup win. A couple of new names have been included in the XI and some regular ones have been rested. They are still favorites to beat the Irish side who have a chance to prove a point. They have lost both the Test matches that they have played till now but would be eager to get their first win. They will have to play out of their skins if they are to do so. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
